author: MarioNawfal
text:
🚨🇩🇪 AfD is leading in a federal voting-intention poll in Germany’s most populous state, North Rhine-Westphalia, for the first time: 24% vs. the CDU’s 22%.

NRW has roughly 18 million residents: more people than live across all of Germany’s eastern states combined.

The result comes after AfD won Saxony-Anhalt’s September 2026 state election with 43.8% of the vote. 

Looks like calling them "far-right" for proposing SANE immigration policies didn't work out so well... 😂

Source: Forsa for the Kölner Stadt-Anzeiger / Writer: Mhedi
